assets.title: Procedural transitions & audio crossfades
assets.format: Local video / audio filters; rendered output format is configurable
assets.description: Make distinct wipes, reveals, pixel transitions, blur, zoom, slides and fades with precise duration and timing, rather than relying on the same downloaded template.
assets.workflow: With an already installed FFmpeg build, normalize two videos to matching frame rate, time base, dimensions and pixel format. Render a chosen xfade option; process audio separately using acrossfade when appropriate. Validate playback in the finished editor.
assets.capcut: Render transitions locally using FFmpeg and import the resulting video into an editor when supported; this is not a native CapCut plugin or automatically installed connector.
assets.license: Open-source executable; LGPL 2.1+ or GPL 2+ depending on build
assets.access: Free open-source command-line tool; local installation required
assets.caveat: Not a stock media license: you still need rights to the input clips and audio. FFmpeg binary redistribution and library linking have LGPL/GPL obligations, depending on enabled features. Check the installed build with ffmpeg -h filter=xfade; no paid API or downloads are initiated here.

steps: Determine subject, mood, audience, format and audio needs before choosing resources.
Offer two or three materially different directions, not cosmetic reskins of one template.
Use distinct primary font pairs, palette, motion language, audio texture and source families when producing consecutive outputs.
Choose resources by source ID; verify each exact item license and destination platform before fetching or exporting.
Prefer new generator seeds and an appropriate original layout over reusing the last graphic composition.
Use only permitted editor integrations. A source link is not an installed plugin or an edit action.
Avoid transitions without purpose. Quality, pacing, readability and emotional fit outrank mere novelty.
Do not feed media-only libraries into AI training. Keep downloaded binaries out of this public link directory.
